notes: v043 is underdetermined and resolves to the base. v044 (r00-base against r01) is the same shape: the projection carries the indefinite τι, for which the ASV writes nothing, so it stands as its own unrepresented unit — rule 97's mirror case, and that citation would be better carried in the unit's own note than only here.
ἀλλήλους heads on another, the word realizing the ἄλλος lexeme, and never on the supplied one (rule 83).
Recitative ὅτι is unrepresented under rule 43; a reference comparison will report it as a disagreement and that report is not a correction.
